mootSayLines.text: Word reaches you, days late: Leroy stands accused over what happened to Eduardo. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
Jesse has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Leroy answers for what happened to Eduardo.
🔴 LIVE! THE MOOT! The fire's built HIGH and the whole GALAXY is watching!
Jesse calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
They're named, every one: Hank Rhee. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Hank nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.

mootSayTvExcluded.text: 📺 TONIGHT: The Moot. Televised trials and debates. The village holds court on camera; the galaxy is the jury.
